title: Expose bounded code-state scan metrics in daemon health
problem: The daemon reports worktree health but not how much bounded discovery work was performed, making scan starvation and reconciliation overhead difficult to diagnose.

acceptanceCriteria.condition: Health reports the most recent bounded file scan count and reconciliation duration without exposing unbounded source data.
Initial indexing and a later reconciliation update the metrics while unchanged files remain free of synthetic graph-update churn.
If the first implementation fails the new lifecycle assertion, the stable evaluator records the exact failing criterion and a bounded retry repairs it without regressing prior tests.
Windows Node 24, Ubuntu Node 22/24, macOS Node 24, release checks, and installed-package smoke all pass.

evidencePlan.coordination: Record pre-change Intent, impact entities, stable N-1 receipts, feedback/retry lineage, and final WorkItem handoff before cleanup.
evidencePlan.evaluation: Bind each evaluation run to the exact stable receipt and preserve the initial failed criterion plus FeedbackPacket.
evidencePlan.correctness: Bind final implementation commit and all remote check-run conclusions.
